title: Audit and wire up remaining drawing tools (pencil, pen, lasso, subselection, ink bottle, eraser)
description: 18 tools appear in the toolbox but several may be icon-only stubs. This task: 1) Audits which tools have real drawing behavior vs. no-op handlers; 2) Implements or completes the most-used ones: Pencil (free-form stroke, merge with existing paths), Pen (bezier anchor placement/editing with cubic/quadratic curves), Subselection (select + drag bezier anchors/handles), Lasso (freehand selection region), Ink Bottle (re-color/re-style stroke of existing shape), Paint Bucket (flood-fill closed region with current fill color). Eraser and Eyedropper are lower priority but should at least not crash. Each tool should produce valid geometry in the document model and persist through undo/redo. Cross-reference docs/03-drawing-vector-graphics.md and docs/04-toolbox.md for behavior spec.
